info.name: Bounding box labeling with SAM 3
info.description: Labels objects with bounding boxes from text prompts using Meta's SAM 3 (Segment Anything 3), which finds every instance of a phrase such as 'hard hat' or 'yellow school bus'. Runs on a Hugging Face Space (eoinedge/sam3 by default), so no GPU spins up in Edge Impulse. Images are sent to that Space.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.help: One object per line: what to look for, then the label and the minimum confidence in parentheses. Short noun phrases work best.
parameters.hint: One object per line, e.g. 'person (person, 0.5)'. Without parentheses the phrase is the label and the minimum confidence is 0.5.

valid.label: Keep them; add only objects that are not already labelled
Replace those whose label is in the prompt

parameters.name: Ignore objects smaller than (%)
parameters.help: Objects whose box covers less than this share of the image are ignored

parameters.name: Ignore objects larger than (%)
parameters.help: Objects whose box covers more than this share of the image are ignored

parameters.name: Non-max suppression
parameters.help: Remove overlapping boxes of the same label, keeping the highest score

parameters.name: NMS IoU threshold
parameters.help: Boxes of the same label that overlap more than this are merged

parameters.name: Hugging Face Space
parameters.help: The Space that runs SAM 3. Duplicate eoinedge/sam3 onto your own hardware for large datasets or private images.

parameters.name: Hugging Face token
parameters.help: Optional. Calls count against this account's ZeroGPU quota instead of the anonymous one; a PRO account gets far more. Needed for a private Space.
